text: Bao. I cook for Hana. Between the pots I kick things.
A cook's hands are for the pot. So the legs do the fighting. It's the kitchen's way.

choices.text: Teach me to fight with my feet.
Show me again how the kitchen fights.

text: Low kick, high kick, the heel from above, and when they crowd you, down on your hands and sweep the floor with them.
I don't teach just anyone. Tomo, my pupil, will spar with you out on the flat. Bare hands, no blades. Put him down and I'll teach you the rest.
Tomo! A guest wants to learn. He'll wait for you out on the flat: go to him when you're ready.
Same as before: weight on the back foot, and let the floor do the work. Gus still kicks like a chair.

bye.text: The stew's on at noon. Don't be late.
